title: P-ContextBench: From Personal Fact Recall to Personalized Agent Behavior
abstract: arXiv:2610.40959v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for personal tasks, yet evaluating their safe use of personal context remains difficult because such contexts are private, fragmented, dynamic, and socially situated. We introduce P-ContextBench, a realistic, verifiable, and scalable benchmark for evaluating personal-context understanding. P-ContextBench constructs population-structured, life-story-grounded digital humans from demographic seeds reflecting the U.S. population. Rather than using explicit, static profiles, P-ContextBench embeds traits, routines, goals, and constraints as implicit evidence across fragmented, evolving synthetic mobile-app records. translated_title: P-ContextBench：从个人事实回忆到个性化智能体行为
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被用于个人任务，然而评估其对个人上下文的安全使用仍然困难，因为这些上下文是私密的、碎片化的、动态的且具有社会情境性。我们提出了P-ContextBench，这是一个真实、可验证且可扩展的个人上下文理解评估基准。P-ContextBench从反映美国人口特征的人口统计种子出发，构建了具有人口结构特征、以人生故事为基础的数字人类。与使用显式的静态档案不同，P-ContextBench将特征、日常习惯、目标和约束作为隐式证据嵌入到碎片化、不断演变的合成移动应用记录中。它评估五种能力：单源事实恢复、多源事实恢复、时间状态追踪、从日常行为推断更高层次的个人模式，以及通过合规、警告等方式安全处理与角色特定约束相冲突的请求。
tldr: 该论文提出了P-ContextBench基准，通过构建基于人口结构、以人生故事为依据的数字人类，并将个人特征作为隐式证据嵌入碎片化的合成移动应用记录中，从事实恢复到安全约束处理五个维度评估大语言模型的个人上下文理解能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces P-ContextBench, a realistic and scalable benchmark that evaluates LLMs' personal-context understanding through population-grounded digital humans with implicit evidence embedded in fragmented synthetic mobile-app records, covering five capabilities from fact recall to safe handling of persona-conflicting requests.
